title: CodeBlock
description: A read-only block of preformatted text (logs, payloads, config) in a named, keyboard-focusable scroll region.

support.notes: Syntax highlighting (core highlightCode, nested text with code-token colors; language="auto" detects it with detectCodeLanguage), opt-in line numbers and language label, character-range marks (nested text backgrounds, mark-click on tap), wrapped/unwrapped text, bounded scrolling maxHeight, native clipboard copy of the raw text with callbacks and localized feedback with cleanup. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

api.notes: Syntax highlighting (core highlightCode, nested text with code-token colors; language="auto" detects it with detectCodeLanguage), opt-in line numbers and language label, character-range marks (nested text backgrounds, mark-click on tap), wrapped/unwrapped text, bounded scrolling maxHeight, native clipboard copy of the raw text with callbacks and localized feedback with cleanup. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: CodeBlock
translationResources.description: A read-only block of preformatted text (logs, payloads, config) in a named, keyboard-focusable scroll region.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Text is rendered verbatim and long lines wrap by default; language="json" highlights the syntax.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: language picks the grammar: JavaScript / TypeScript (JSX, TSX), JSON, CSS, HTML, Bash, Python, YAML, SQL, diff and Markdown (common aliases such as ts, sh, py, yml, md work). showLanguage adds a small label; other languages render plain text.

auto-language.title: Automatic language
auto-language.description: For code whose language is unknown (e.g. an EPUB <pre> without a class), language="auto" detects it from the text with a fast heuristic over its first 4 KB, then highlights it and labels the detected language; when unsure it stays "plain". Marks keep working. detectCodeLanguage of minerva-design/core runs the same detection on its own.

line-numbers.title: Line numbers
line-numbers.description: showLineNumbers numbers the lines in a gutter hidden from screen readers; the numbers are not selected or copied with the code.

no-wrap.title: Scrolling logs
no-wrap.description: wrap={false} keeps lines intact and scrolls horizontally; maxHeight bounds the block.

copyable.title: Copy button
copyable.description: copyable adds a copy button in the top-right corner; the result ("Copied" / "Copy failed") is shown on the button and announced to screen readers. onCopied receives the copied text after a successful copy.

marks.title: Marks (saved highlights)
marks.description: marks lays character ranges over the syntax colors (offsets into the code; overlapping marks: the later one wins). getCodeSelectionRange of minerva-design/core turns the user's selection into offsets to save; onMarkClick reports the clicked mark (here: removes it). Copy still copies the raw code.

CodeBlockProps.aria-label: Accessible name of the code region
CodeBlockProps.wrap: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling horizontally
CodeBlockProps.maxHeight: Maximum height before the block scrolls
CodeBlockProps.tabIndex: Tab order of the region (focusable by default)
CodeBlockProps.copyable: Shows a copy button that writes the text to the clipboard and announces the result
CodeBlockProps.onCopied: Called with the copied text after the copy button wrote it to the clipboard (not on failure); the native onCopy still goes to the element
CodeBlockProps.language: Language of the code: highlights its syntax (javascript, typescript, jsx, tsx, json, css, html, bash, python, yaml, sql, diff, markdown and their aliases); "auto" detects it from the code (detectCodeLanguage, "plain" when unsure), reflected by the label, class and data-language; without it the text is plain
CodeBlockProps.highlight: Highlights the syntax of language (false: plain text)
CodeBlockProps.showLineNumbers: Numbers the lines in a gutter (hidden from assistive technology, not copied)
CodeBlockProps.showLanguage: Shows the language as a small label in the top-right corner
CodeBlockProps.marks: Character ranges to mark (saved highlights, annotations): { start, end, color?, className?, id?, title? } with UTF-16 offsets into the code, rendered as <mark> over the syntax colors. Ranges are clamped, empty ones ignored; where marks overlap, the later one wins. color is a theme color name (a translucent tint) or any CSS color
CodeBlockProps.onMarkClick: Called with the mark (the topmost where marks overlap) and the event when a mark is clicked, not at the end of a selection drag

cssVars.--code-block-max-height: Maximum height before the block scrolls (default: none)
cssVars.--code-block-mark-bg: Default background of the marks (a translucent yellow)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The text content is rendered verbatim (escape < in markup); language highlights the syntax and show-language shows a label. Each block is a named, focusable region.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: language picks the grammar (ts, css, html, bash, python, diff…); show-language adds a small label. The code property holds the text, never parsed as HTML.

auto-language.title: Automatic language
auto-language.description: language="auto" detects the language of unlabelled code from its text (detectCodeLanguage of minerva-design/core; "plain" when unsure); show-language, class and data-language show the detected one.

line-numbers.title: Line numbers
line-numbers.description: show-line-numbers numbers the lines in a gutter hidden from screen readers; copy still copies the raw text.

copy.title: Copy to clipboard
copy.description: The code property holds the text; copyable adds a copy button, copy() copies from outside and minerva-copy reports the result.

overflow.title: Long lines and height
overflow.description: no-wrap scrolls long lines horizontally and max-height caps the block; the region scrolls with the keyboard too.

marks.title: Marks (saved highlights)
marks.description: marks lays character ranges over the syntax colors; getSelectionRange() maps the user's selection to offsets and minerva-mark-click reports the clicked mark (here: removes it).

props.code: Source text (default: the element's text content).
props.language: Language of the code: highlights its syntax and sets class="language-<x>" / data-language on the <code>. "auto" detects it from the text (detectCodeLanguage; "plain" when unsure).
props.noHighlight: Keeps the code plain despite language (the React library's highlight={false}).
props.noWrap: Scrolls long lines horizontally instead of wrapping them (the React library's wrap={false}).
props.showLineNumbers: Numbers the lines in a gutter (aria-hidden, not part of the copied text).
props.showLanguage: Shows the language as a small label in the top-right corner (e.g. "JSON").
props.marks: Character ranges to mark ({ start, end, color?, className?, id?, title? }, UTF-16 offsets into the text): the property or a JSON array attribute. The later of overlapping marks wins.
props.clickableMarks: Gives the marks a click affordance (pointer cursor, hover underline); set it when listening to minerva-mark-click.

events.minerva-copy: The copy button or copy() was used (detail: { text, success }; text is the copied text, React's onCopied receives it on success).
events.minerva-mark-click: A mark was clicked, not at the end of a selection drag (detail: { mark, originalEvent }; React's onMarkClick).

cssVars.--icon-button-color: Icon color of the copy button.
cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: Background of the copy button on hover.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of a pressed copy button.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-bg: Background of a pressed copy button.
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the copy button.
cssVars.--icon-button-icon-size: Font size of the copy icon.
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the copy button.

methods.copy: Copies the text to the clipboard; resolves with whether it worked.
methods.getSelectionRange: Offsets in text of the user's selection inside the code ({ start, end, text }), or null; reads the selection through the shadow root.

native.limitations: Native CodeBlock uses a maximum height of 384 density-independent pixels, corresponding to the web default of 24rem at a 16px root size. Pass copyText to connect Expo Clipboard on iOS and Android.
